definitions.short: Shaalbim or Shaalabbin , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H8169. Shaalbim שַׁעַלְבִים proper name, of a location (perhaps haunt of foxes ; Arabic , Assyrian šêlibu , fox ); — in (original) territory of Dan, Judg 1:35 (compare GFM, on etymology and site), 1Kin 4:9 , Θαλαβεειν , Σαλαβειμ , Judges also αἱ ἀλώπεκες , as doublet, or (A ᵐ5 L ) alone; = שַׁעֲלַבִּין Josh 19:42 , Σα ( α ) λαβειν . שַׁעֲלַבִּין see foregoing.
